## Où j'en suis

SAML ACS verification is implemented with signxml, not python3-saml. It checks the XML signature, the conditions (time window with a 120 s skew, audience, recipient), and assertion replay via Redis, and reads attributes only from the signed element. The changes are in PR #412 (commits 3f9c2a1, b71e04d, e0a5c93), with tests passing and CI green. The Fernhill staging IdP metadata is not loaded yet, and the demo is Thursday 10:00 New York, so metadata must be exchanged by Wednesday EOD.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill staging IdP metadata into the tenant config
- [prochaine-étape] Send Fernhill our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD (demo Thursday 10:00 NY)
- [prochaine-étape] Ping Maya for review on PR #412
- [prochaine-étape] Create a separate ticket to enforce SSO and disable password login for Fernhill users
- [essai-raté] python3-saml on the Alpine image: xmlsec/lxml libxml2 mismatch; building lxml from source (9 min build) still failed on the crypto library. Dropped in favour of signxml.
- [question] PR #412 status: the facts record it as merged, but the last agent message says it is blocked awaiting Maya's approval, and the merge attempt failed. Confirm which is true.
- [décision] Use signxml and drop python3-saml and xmlsec (source: t08)
- [décision] Clock skew set to 120 s, per the Fernhill security questionnaire; password login left untouched (source: t12)
- [décision] Move saml_utils into api/auth/saml/verify.py (source: t14)
- [décision] No admin or auto merge; the user will ping Maya directly (source: t21)
